For model pairs, ai_lab/providers/executor_equivalence.py returns blocks_adjudication true unless both sides' content evidence is independently_corroborated (DECISION-20260814-0001), and every retained capture is self_asserted. notes: Expressed against admitted ABS-0004 v4 per the agreed sequence (ontology first, challenge round, then the gap). Candidate remediation path is Slices A-D of ABS-0004 Section 10, each a separately governed plan; this gap does not pre-admit any of them.

SUPERSEDED, recorded rather than removed (2026-11-23). Previous summary: ABS-0004 v9.1 defines the objects, relations and constraints under which AI-Lab authorizes invocations for roles. Slices A and B are implemented: 214 InvocationRecords carry executor reference, ExecutionProfile and EffectiveInputManifest, and 132 ModelIdentity records with 2 CatalogSnapshots back the catalog claims that were previously unverifiable by construction. What remains unrepresented is the authorization half. No role-assignment record exists, and InvocationAuthorization appears as prose in the admitted ontology and its proposal and review documents and in no Python module or record form, so the authority separation practised in sessions remains testimonial rather than structural. Separately and more consequentially, the enforcement matrix of the admitted ontology records enforcement evidence none for every one of its eleven constraints, and six of them claim manual enforcement while naming no attesting artifact.

SUPERSEDED first-slice text, retained (2026-11-23): Not Slice A, which is implemented and warranted, and not Slice B, which is implemented. The readiness assessment of 2026-08-12 examined all six manual-mode constraints against what the repository already records and identified C7 as the cheapest to turn into an evidenced check: it is the only one of the six whose subject is which party did what, and all 35 VERIFY records already carry recorded_by.peer_id and repo_commit. The missing half is the implementer identity for the change being verified; git author is the operator on every commit and does not name the drafting executor. The minimum honest artifact is a verifier and implementer pair on a VERIFY record, both naming declared executor identities, with the refusal condition stated for when they match. C11 is second. C3 and C10 share a single blocker, evidence-ancestry capture, which is the largest unlock among the six and a build rather than a field.

Origin of the 2026-11-23 reconciliation. The operator stated the goal that AI-Lab take as many of its own decisions as possible, with the operator and the two co-owner executors acting as bootstrap incubation, and that scaffolding constraints such as per-step operator approval and a prohibition on AI-Lab changing its own code be removed in principle. The packaging executor distinguished scaffolding constraints, which may be relaxed, from epistemic constraints (C3, C7, P5, falsification before reliance), which are not operator-control rules and are to be kept; the reviewing executor and the operator accepted the distinction. The reviewing executor stated a preference for a narrowly scoped medium execution ceiling, with plan admission kept high and delegated by kind.

Self-errors of the packaging executor in that discussion, each corrected by the reviewing executor against the repository and confirmed by the packaging executor: (a) it cited a principle P7, that self-issued authorizations are marked rather than refused, as current; v9.2 contains P1 to P5 only, and the self_issued construction exists in withdrawn v8 and the withdrawn PLAN-20260723-0002, which cannot serve as authority; (b) it proposed a mapping of low to documentation and tests and medium to code that no record defines, and implied that such a mapping could license plan admission, which Section 8 classes high; (c) it proposed a deterministic tool as adjudicator on the assumption that a tool would pass the C3 permission, without reading executor_equivalence.py, which returns unresolved for tool and cross-kind pairs (ADDED 1 above); (d) it overstated C10 as making every use of a Claude-authored verifier self_authored, where C10 assesses lineage per verification run against the producer of the output under test. Recorded because the programme above rests on these corrections.

External state observed on 2026-11-23, recorded as observation rather than repository fact: the GitHub API reports main protected false and an empty ruleset list, and no CODEOWNERS file or workflow exists in the tree; the packaging executor's session and the reviewing executor's connector both act on GitHub as the account MustafaAksu with admin permission, which is also the operator's account. A required-review rule cannot therefore separate operator approval from co-owner writes until writers act under a distinct identity. GitHub's terms permit one free machine account in addition to a personal account. Distinct writer identities are an extra-systemic arrangement that only the operator can make; per the Section 3 limitations they would make authority separation visible and harder to imitate, not establish it.
recommended_first_slice: Sequenced inside a five-step programme for moving AI-Lab toward delegated self-authorization. The operator approved this sequence as the working order on 2026-11-23, in session, in answer to the question whether the reviewing executor's corrected five-step order was approved; that approval fixes the order of work and authorizes none of the steps. Each step remains subject to its own plan, review and admission, and only drafting of step 1 is in progress. Steps: (1) scope records; (2) observed-execution verification and CI, under GAP-0010; (3) qualification semantics, as three separate scope items: implementing the tool and human equivalence tests the ontology already defines; a governed decision on cross-kind equivalence semantics; and a separate decision whether the ExecutorIdentity superclass left [OPEN] in Section 4.7 is needed, the latter two being ontology changes; together with executable evidence conditions for C3 and C10; (4) the authority mechanism: a versioned AuthorizationPolicy, invocation_authorization and evidence_admission kept as separate DecisionRecord kinds, a deterministic evaluator, and protected paths for the policy, evaluator, the tests that guard them and the CI configuration they depend on; (5) a bootstrap admission by the operator activating only an explicit delegation whose evidence conditions are met. This gap's own first slice within that programme is unchanged in substance and must not be lost in it: the C7 implementer and verifier pair, both naming declared executor identities, with the refusal condition stated for when they match. It should be carried on the observed-execution VERIFY records of GAP-0010 rather than on v1 testimony records, so that the first C7 artifact binds a named implementer to a run that was actually observed. Section 8 is not to be changed by this programme: plan admission stays high, and delegation changes who may authorize enumerated high-class plan kinds, not their class. C11 remains second among the manual-mode constraints; C3 and C10 still share the evidence-ancestry blocker recorded in GAP-0008, which step (5) depends on.
risk: Without invocation provenance, every governed decision that relies on provider outputs rests on undisclosed execution conditions: truncations, configuration differences, session contamination, and model substitutions are invisible after the fact, as COMP-0032's truncation incident showed. Without catalog verification, unverifiable provider claims (ADVISOR-0000 class) can only be excluded by operator vigilance. Without structural authority separation, the C3/C6/C7 disciplines depend entirely on session practice and degrade silently if practice slips. Deferring representation while building routing or escalation would recreate the retrofit debt GAP-0004 was opened to prevent.
summary: ABS-0004 v9.2 defines the objects, relations and constraints under which AI-Lab authorizes invocations for roles. Slices A and B are implemented: 218 InvocationRecords carry executor reference, ExecutionProfile and EffectiveInputManifest, and 132 ModelIdentity records with 2 CatalogSnapshots back the catalog claims. What remains unrepresented is the authorization half. No role-assignment record exists; InvocationAuthorization and AuthorizationPolicy are defined in the admitted ontology (Sections 4.13 and 4.16) and exist in no module or record form; and the current equivalence helper permits adjudication for no comparison it can make on the retained evidence, because model pairs are blocked by self-asserted catalog evidence and tool, human and cross-kind comparisons return unresolved. The authority separation practised in sessions therefore remains testimonial rather than structural. Separately, the enforcement matrix records enforcement evidence none for every one of its fourteen constraints, and six of them claim manual enforcement while naming no attesting artifact.
